rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found. Test flakiness note: pytest-asyncio 1.4 defaults to function-scoped event loops, but the FastAPI app-wide motor client (routers.database.get_db) binds to whichever loop first executes, so subsequent tests hit 'Event loop is closed'. Fixed by setting asyncio_default_test_loop_scope=session in /app/backend/pytest.ini and using pytest_asyncio.fixture with loop_scope='session' for the db fixture.
